positions.name: ErasureDirectiveScope
positions.frame: when a directive commands that knowledge be forgotten or removed, whose authority is enacted and what scope of knowledge is being placed off-limits?
positions.why: Both expressions are flat, present-tense imperatives issued in a formal, distance-keeping register (relational: authority-ranking; power: coercive/informational; value: autonomy; conviction: decision, unhedged) directing that a category of knowledge — first 'the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts,' then 'zeppelin routes' — be discarded from what is retained. The pair coheres as one directional read: an authority move enacted through commanding erasure rather than through argument or discussion. No tension between them — src-2 narrows/extends the same erasure act src-1 opens, both targeting classes of knowledge rather than single instances. Settled binding for both segments already established 'new' — no prior graph content to consult or attach against.
